arxiv-1706-02715.title: Causes and Corrections for Bimodal Multipath Scanning with Structured Light
arxiv-1706-02715.creator: Yu Zhang, Daniel L. Lau, Ying Yu
arxiv-1706-02715.description: A 2017 arXiv research paper by Yu Zhang, Daniel L. Lau, Ying Yu. Structured light illumination is an active 3-D scanning technique based on projecting/capturing a set of striped patterns and measuring the warping of the patterns as they reflect off a target object’s surface.

arxiv-2106-11510.title: Sub- and Super-solution Approach to Accuracy Analysis of Portfolio Optimization Asymptotics in Multiscale Stochastic Factor Markets
arxiv-2106-11510.creator: Jean-Pierre Fouque, Ruimeng Hu, Ronnie Sircar
arxiv-2106-11510.description: Abstract The problem of portfolio optimization when stochastic factors drive returns and volatilities has been studied in previous works by the authors. In particular, they proposed asymptotic approximations for value functions and optimal strategies in the regime where these factors are running on both slow and fast timescales.

arxiv-2302-12878.title: Causal quartets: Different ways to attain the same average treatment effect We thank Dan Goldstein, Stephen Stigler, and Howard Wainer for helpful comments and the U.S. Office of Naval Research and Institute of Education Sciences for partial support of this work.
arxiv-2302-12878.creator: Andrew Gelman, Jessica Hullman, Lauren Kennedy
arxiv-2302-12878.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by Andrew Gelman, Jessica Hullman, Lauren Kennedy. The average causal effect can often be best understood in the context of its variation. We demonstrate with two sets of four graphs, all of which represent the same average effect but with much different patterns of heterogeneity. As with the famous correlation quartet of Anscombe (1973), these graphs dramatize the way in which real-world variation can be more complex than simple numerical summaries.

arxiv-2401-05715.title: Recoverable robust shortest path problem under interval budgeted uncertainty representations
arxiv-2401-05715.creator: Marcel Jackiewicz, Adam Kasperski, Paweł Zieliński
arxiv-2401-05715.description: Abstract This paper deals with the recoverable robust shortest path problem under interval uncertainty representations. In this problem, a first-stage path is computed, which can be modified to some extent after observing changes in the cost structure. The uncertain second-stage arc costs are modeled by intervals, and the robust min-max criterion is used to compute an optimal solution.

arxiv-2403-10935.title: Understanding Robustness of Visual State Space Models for Image Classification
arxiv-2403-10935.creator: Chengbin Du, Yanxi Li, Chang Xu
arxiv-2403-10935.description: Abstract Visual State Space Model (VMamba) has recently emerged as a promising architecture, exhibiting remarkable performance in various computer vision tasks. However, its robustness has not yet been thoroughly studied. In this paper, we delve into the robustness of this architecture through comprehensive investigations from multiple perspectives.

arxiv-2403-11983.title: Proposal of a general framework to categorize continuous predictor variables
arxiv-2403-11983.creator: Irantzu Barrio, Javier Roca-Pardiñas, Cristobal Esteban, Maria Durban
arxiv-2403-11983.description: Abstract The use of discretized variables in the development of prediction models is a common practice, in part because the decision-making process is more natural when it is based on rules created from segmented models. Although this practice is perhaps more common in medicine, it is extensible to any area of knowledge where a predictive model helps in decision-making.

arxiv-2504-02417.title: Leveraging Static Relationships for Intra-Type and Inter-Type Message Passing in Video Question Answering
arxiv-2504-02417.creator: Lili Liang, Guanglu Sun
arxiv-2504-02417.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Lili Liang, Guanglu Sun. Video Question Answering (VideoQA) is an important research direction in the field of artificial intelligence, enabling machines to understand video content and perform reasoning and answering based on natural language questions. Although methods based on static relationship reasoning have made certain progress, there are still deficiencies in the accuracy of static relationship recognition and representation, and they have not fully utilized the static relationship information in videos for in-depth reasoning and analysis.

arxiv-2504-17864.title: A Newton-type Method for Non-smooth Under-determined Systems of Equations
arxiv-2504-17864.creator: Titus Pinta
arxiv-2504-17864.description: Abstract We study a variant of Newton’s algorithm applied to under-determined systems of non-smooth equations. The notion of regularity employed in our work is based on Newton differentiability, which generalizes semi-smoothness. The classic notion of Newton differentiability does not suffice for our purpose, due to the existence of multiple zeros and as such we extend it to uniform Newton differentiability.

europmc-pmc2124703.title: ON THE RELATION OF TETANY TO THE PARATHYROID GLANDS AND TO CALCIUM METABOLISM.
europmc-pmc2124703.creator: Maccallum WG, Voegtlin C.
europmc-pmc2124703.description: 1. Tetany occurs spontaneously in many forms and may also be produced by the destruction of the parathyroid glands. Recent researches tend to demonstrate an intimate relation between the various forms of tetany and relative or absolute insufficiency of the parathyroid gland. 2....

plos-pone-0003107.creator: Andrej Benjak, Astrid Forneck, Josep M. Casacuberta
plos-pone-0003107.description: PLOS ONE research article. The grapevine is a widely cultivated crop and a high number of different varieties have been selected since its domestication in the Neolithic period. Although sexual crossing has been a major driver of grapevine evolution, its vegetative propagation enhanced the impact of somati

pmc-10708187.title: Nutrition, Immune Function, and Infectious Disease in Military Personnel: A Narrative Review
pmc-10708187.creator: Adrienne Hatch-McChesney, Tracey J Smith
pmc-10708187.description: Consuming a diet that meets energy demands and provides essential nutrients promotes a healthy immune system, while both under- and over-nutrition have been associated with immune dysfunction. Military personnel comprise a unique population who frequently endure multi-stressor environments, predisposing them to immune decrements. Additionally, 49% and 22% of active duty U.S. military personnel are classified as overweight and obese, respectively.

pmc-11535153.title: A germline PAF1 paralog complex ensures cell type-specific gene expression
pmc-11535153.creator: Astrid Pold Vilstrup, Archica Gupta, Anna Jon Rasmussen, Anja Ebert, Sebastian Riedelbauch, Marie Vestergaard Lukassen, Rippei Hayashi, Peter Andersen
pmc-11535153.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). In this study, Vilstrup et al. identify a testis-specific paralog of the polymerase-associated factor 1 complex (tPAF) that drives efficient transcription termination of genes activated by testis-specific TBP-associated factors (tTAFs). pmc-11591436.title: Antimicrobial Peptide Delivery Systems as Promising Tools Against Resistant Bacterial Infections
pmc-11591436.creator: Kamila Botelho Sampaio de Oliveira, Michel Lopes Leite, Nadielle Tamires Moreira Melo, Letícia Ferreira Lima, Talita Cristina Queiroz Barbosa, Nathalia Lira Carmo, Douglas Afonso Bittencourt Melo, Hugo Costa Paes, Octávio Luiz Franco
pmc-11591436.description: The extensive use of antibiotics during recent years has led to antimicrobial resistance development, a significant threat to global public health. It is estimated that around 1.27 million people died worldwide in 2019 due to infectious diseases caused by antibiotic-resistant microorganisms, according to the WHO.

pmc-12444481.title: Beyond conventional treatment: Novel cell therapies for systemic lupus erythematosus
pmc-12444481.creator: Zeinab Zarei-Behjani, Arghavan Hosseinpouri, Maryam Fotoohi, Akram Shafiee, Dorna Asadi
pmc-12444481.description: Systemic lupus erythematosus (SLE) is an autoimmune disease characterized by its heterogeneity, as it can affect various organs and exhibit a diverse clinical progression. The identification of SLE relies on the presence of distinct clinical manifestations in the skin, joints, kidneys, and the central nervous system, along with serological markers like antinuclear antibodies such as antibodies targeting dsDNA.

pmc-12560585.title: Drivers of managed entry agreements to reduce reimbursement challenges of orphan medicinal products: the development of a matrix
pmc-12560585.creator: Marcelien H E Callenbach, Sibren van den Berg, Alisa Hulsbosch, Carla E M Hollak, Christine Leopold, Aukje K Mantel-Teeuwisse, Wim G Goettsch
pmc-12560585.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). BackgroundReimbursing orphan medicinal products (OMPs) presents both opportunities and challenges for national healthcare payers and health technology assessment (HTA) bodies because of their potential high benefits, large clinical uncertainties and high prices.

pmc-12642333.title: Timing of mortality during development alters the evolution of aging
pmc-12642333.creator: Peter Lenart, Sacha Psalmon, Benjamin D Towbin
pmc-12642333.description: BackgroundFor most animals, intrinsic senescence-induced mortality increases with age, while deaths from extrinsic threats, such as predation or accidents, decline during development as individuals grow and mature. Age-dependent modulation of extrinsic mortality is known to influence the evolution of aging. Yet, how the precise timing of changes in mortality shapes evolutionary forces, i.e.

pmc-12655364.title: Cation Induced Structural Variation in Topochemically Modified Dion-Jacobson Perovskite Solid Solutions
pmc-12655364.creator: Roshni Bhuvan, Gary J Sandrock, Sara Akbarian-Tefaghi, Mya Kelch, Mark Granier, John B Wiley, Jürgen Köhler
pmc-12655364.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). The continuous solid solution series based on the ion exchangeable Dion-Jacobson layered perovskites, A1−xA′xLaNb2O7 (A/A′ = Li, Na, K, Rb, Cs; 0 ≤ x ≤ 1), has been investigated to illuminate the relationship between composition and structure. Topochemical synthesis of the solid solutions from combinations of various alkali metal cations has been achieved by reacting pure end members (ALaNb2O7) at appropriate ratios and temperatures.

pmc-12775075.title: Third-generation Cephalosporin resistance in Sub-Saharan Africa: a systematic review and meta-analysis
pmc-12775075.creator: Giacomo Guido, Luisa Frallonardo, Muhammad Asaduzzaman, Ferenc Balázs Farkas, Elda De Vita, Amir Seni, Sergio Cotugno, Roberta Papagni, Elmano Gomonda, Francesco Vladimiro Segala, Emanuele Nicastri, Federico Gobbi, Laura B Nellums, Roberta Iatta, Kajal Chhaganlal, Nicola Veronese, Giovanni Putoto, C
pmc-12775075.description: BackgroundAntimicrobial resistance is a critical global health threat, with Sub-Saharan Africa disproportionately affected. Third-generation cephalosporins are widely used for severe infections due to their safety, broad spectrum, and effectiveness. However, resistance to third-generation cephalosporins undermines treatment and exacerbates poor outcomes in regions with limited alternative therapies.

pmc-12788000.title: Enhancing Cryopreservation Efficiency in Populus davidiana × P. tremuloides Shoot Tips: Optimization of Vitrification Protocols and Mechanistic Insights into Flavonoid-Mediated Stress Adaptation
pmc-12788000.creator: Panke Yang, Zelin Li, Yu Qi, Yuandong Ma, Chunming Li, Maolan Liu, Wenjun Ma, Hui Bai, Huanzhen Liu
pmc-12788000.description: Cryopreservation is vital for conserving the elite germplasm of the hybrid poplar Populus davidiana × P. tremuloides, which is difficult to propagate conventionally. This study established optimized vitrification and encapsulation–vitrification protocols, achieving high regeneration rates of 85.91% and 79.70%, respectively, with confirmed genetic stability. The process induced oxidative stress, altering markers (MDA, H2O2) and antioxidant enzyme activities (SOD, POD, CAT).

pmc-13320061.title: Upper gastrointestinal hemorrhage due to splenic artery pseudoaneurysm combined with pancreatic pseudocyst recurrence: A case report
pmc-13320061.creator: Jiandong Liu, Min Liang, Yanglin Pan, Zhigao Xu, Dahai Shi, Jinhong Yu
pmc-13320061.description: Intracapsular hemorrhage occurs occasionally in acute pancreatitis complicated with pseudocyst that can be managed using laparoscopic gastric cyst anastomosis and drainage. However, cyst recurrence many years later and secondary splenic artery pseudoaneurysm rupture and hemorrhage leading to bloody vomiting and syncope are uncommonly reported. A woman in her late 40s was admitted for bloody vomiting, melena, anemia, and syncope.

pmc-13431123.title: Correction to: Ghost-rocks’ microbiota: metagenomic insights into their influence on the biogeochemistry of karstic cave and groundwater
pmc-13431123.creator: Unknown
pmc-13431123.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). In this work, metagenomes from the Artic, Baltic Sea, and Antarctic sea ice were analyzed, revealing insights into genetic diversity, virus-host interactions, and functional roles of viruses in sea ice. This is a correction to: Guillaume Peugnet, Céline Pisapia, Bénédicte Ménez, Maud Watkinson, Léna Lecourt, Nicolas Peugnet, Julien Bouchez, Laurent Bruxelles, Emmanuelle Gérard, Ghost-rocks’ microbiota: metagenomic insights into their influence on the biogeochemistry of karstic cave and groundwater, FEMS Microbiology Ecology, Volume 102, Issue 6, June 2026, fiag047, https://doi.org/10.1093/femsec/fiag047.
